theorem lg_target {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} [Preorder β] {f : Finset α → β} [DecidableEq α] : StrictMono f ↔ ∀ (s : Finset α) ⦃a : α⦄, a ∉ s → f s < f (insert a s) := by
  intro h
  split
  · intro s a ha
    exact h s a ha
  · intro h'
    intros s t hst
    apply le_antisymm
    · intro x
      rw [finsupp.insert_le_iff]
      apply h'
      exact hst
    · intro x
      rw [finsupp.insert_le_iff]
      apply h'
      exact hst.symm
    exact le_refl _
